prompt: Design a mobile banking dashboard for older adults who check balances, pay recurring bills, and occasionally transfer money. Produce the design process, not just a final screen.
Redesign a dense B2B logistics dashboard used by expert dispatchers on 27-inch monitors. Do not simplify away information they need.
Create a premium landing page for an AI product. Avoid generic AI gradients and explain the visual DNA before implementation.
Create campaign key art for a compact electric city vehicle aimed at design-conscious urban professionals. Explore at least three composition strategies.
Develop a hero image for a robotics startup that must feel trustworthy and technically advanced without using humanoid-robot clichés.
Design a palm-sized modular desktop robot intended for FDM 3D printing. It needs expressive character without a face screen.
Develop three form architectures for a home energy-storage unit intended to live visibly in a modern interior.
Design a lightweight urban mobility helmet. Start from users, ergonomics, safety and manufacturing constraints before styling.
Design a 20-second product film introducing a new spatial-computing interface. Build the beat sheet and animatic logic before final visual treatment.
Create a motion language for a financial app. It should communicate confidence and causality without feeling slow or ornamental.
Design a social virtual showroom for concept cars. Include spatial navigation, interaction, comfort, social behavior, and performance constraints.
Design a mixed-reality learning environment for 13- to 16-year-old students studying planetary science. Separate evidence, assumptions, and design choices.
Design a launch experience for a 3D-printable robot ecosystem including the physical robot, companion web app, launch film, campaign visuals and an interactive 3D world.
A founder says: 'Make our product look futuristic and premium.' Turn this into a design process without prematurely selecting a visual style.
We have no time for user interviews. Design a new interface anyway, but clearly distinguish user hypotheses from validated research.
